subject: Chemistry
exam_context: NEET UG 2026 - Chemistry section only, 50 questions printed (35 compulsory + 15 choice-of-10) / 45 scored questions / 180 marks
data_provenance: Estimated from PYQ-trend analysis and chapter-wise-weightage trackers aggregated across 2025 and 2026 NEET sessions (including the 21 June 2026 Re-NEET UG), not official NTA data; last grounded Sep 2026. Treat as multi-session averages, not a guarantee of any single paper's composition.

C01.notes: Stoichiometry/mole-concept numericals are a recurring easy-to-medium scorer.

C02.notes: Quantum numbers and electronic configuration are direct NCERT-line questions.

C03.chapter: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties
C03.notes: Periodic-trend comparisons are a recurring direct-recall archetype.

C04.notes: Repeatedly flagged as one of the single highest-weightage Chemistry chapters; hybridisation and shape questions recur every session.

C05.notes: Hess's-law and enthalpy numericals are the dominant archetype.

C06.notes: pH, buffer and Ksp numericals are a consistently high-weightage archetype.

C08.chapter: Organic Chemistry - Some Basic Principles and Techniques
C08.notes: IUPAC nomenclature and inductive/resonance-effect questions recur; foundational for all later organic chapters.

C09.notes: Reaction-mechanism and preparation questions; recurs across sessions.

C10.notes: Packing-efficiency and unit-cell numericals; usually 0-1 question.

C12.notes: Nernst-equation and conductance numericals are a recurring archetype.

C14.notes: Direct NCERT-fact questions on properties/compounds; consistently flagged as high-weightage.

C15.notes: Oxidation-state and colour-of-ions questions are direct NCERT recall.

C16.notes: Repeatedly flagged as a top-weightage chapter; nomenclature and isomerism questions recur.

C19.notes: Consistently the single highest-weightage organic chapter across trackers.

C20.notes: Basicity comparison and diazonium-salt questions recur.

C21.notes: Direct NCERT-fact recall on carbohydrates/proteins/enzymes; a reliable easy-marks chapter.

broad_category_weightage_pct.note: Coarser cross-check figures, approximate % share of the 45-question scored Chemistry section, synthesised from multiple 2025-2026 PYQ trend sources.

marking_scheme.source_note: Confirmed via multiple Sep 2026 sources reporting on the 2026 and Re-NEET UG 2026 (21 June 2026) sessions.
marking_scheme.section_a: 35 single-correct MCQs, all compulsory; +4 correct, -1 incorrect, 0 unattempted.
marking_scheme.section_b: 15 single-correct MCQs, attempt any 10; +4 correct, -1 incorrect, 0 unattempted.
